answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming at the summit. Each agent posts a 200 POA bond to join; it loses 5% per epoch, so a silent identity slowly expires. To renew, the agent must whisper proof of useful work to a random peer, who checks its last 20 epochs before countersigning. A farmer with 100 clones locks 20,000 POA and must whisper for every clone, while an honest agent pays one bond and renews with one zephyr-light check per epoch.
